seo.title: MAGLUMI Thyroid Tests | LabWell
seo.description: Explore the Thyroid group in the MAGLUMI CLIA menu, view the complete Snibe assay list, and ask LabWell about the analyzer series for your laboratory.

hero.lead: The Thyroid group in the MAGLUMI CLIA menu helps laboratories find the relevant assays and explore the complete Snibe menu.
